name: syntheo
description: Search and read local Syntheo meetings through the local CLI or the local stdio MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Find meetings and read notes, summaries, participants, action items, bounded transcript excerpts, and recurring history from the local Syntheo database, through the Syntheo CLI or the local stdio MCP server. Nothing goes through a hosted service, and no account is needed. Stage note or summary edits for review in the desktop app, and export complete meeting records when requested.
defaultPrompt: What action items came out of my planning meeting?
Compare the last three meetings in this recurring series.
